description: First harness-computed baseline on curated golden-set v1 (117 items), measured against the full Phase 2 hybrid pipeline (dense + sparse + RRF fusion + MiniLM cross-encoder rerank, parent-chunk expansion) and self-hosted generation/judging (qwen3:4b-instruct via Ollama for both, per the 2026-08-01 self-hosted-only decision). Every future retrieval/generation change is measured as a delta vs this config (SPEC.md §7.2); evals.yml's CI gate compares PR metrics to this file.

corpus.source: arXiv LLM/RAG papers, discovered via arXiv API (scripts/seed_demo_corpus.py)

golden_set.note: target composition was ~120/55/30/25/10; landed at 23 unanswerable after dedup (see DECISIONS.md 2026-08-01 on GEN_TEMPERATURE=0.1 diversity collapse). Generated + judged fully self-hosted (qwen3:4b-instruct), not Gemini as originally planned.

full_pipeline_subset.note: generation+judge metrics (faithfulness/answer_correctness/context_precision/context_recall/abstention) computed on every 3rd item of the pre-shuffled full.jsonl, stratified by construction (DECISIONS.md 2026-08-01). Retrieval metrics (hit_rate/MRR/NDCG@10) computed on all 117 items — cheap, no generation needed.

latency_ms.note: per-item wall clock including retrieval-only items (~seconds) and full-pipeline items (generation+judge, 150-450s+ each) mixed together — not a query-latency SLO number, see SPEC.md §7.2's separate p95 latency gate (not yet measured, load-test only)

vs_spec_targets.note: SPEC.md §7.2 targets vs this baseline, for visibility — not all targets are CI-gated yet (evals.yml gates hard-fail only on hit_rate/NDCG@10 per the fixture-corpus smoke test; the full golden-set-v1 regression rule in this file is the source of truth for future manual/local comparisons per DECISIONS.md 2026-08-01).
vs_spec_targets.judge_metrics_caveat: faithfulness/context_recall/answer_correctness fall short of SPEC.md targets — expected, and consistent with the 2026-08-01 decision to stay fully self-hosted: the spec explicitly names the 4B local model as weakest at exactly the judge and testset-generation jobs. Retrieval metrics (hit_rate/NDCG@10/context_precision) and abstention behavior, which don't depend on judge quality, all meet or exceed target. Revisit judge metrics if/when a stronger judge (e.g. Gemini) is wired in — no harness changes needed, just a re-run.
